entries.title: Calling the neighbors
entries.literal_meaning: Provisional rendering: I built a house at the village’s edge; come running, neighbors—a thief has entered my house.
entries.explanation: The speaker places the house at the village’s edge and calls others toward a reported intrusion. The headword explains people running to assemble. Our reading notices the turn from a house described as mine to a call addressed outward. The quotation does not say that anyone came or establish that the reported theft occurred.
entries.meaning_odia: ବକ୍ତା ଗାଁ ମୁଣ୍ଡରେ ନିଜ ଘର କଥା କହି ଚୋର ପଶିଥିବା ଜଣାଇ ଅନ୍ୟମାନଙ୍କୁ ଡାକୁଛନ୍ତି। ଶବ୍ଦର ଅର୍ଥରେ ଲୋକେ ଦଉଡ଼ି ଆସି ଏକାଠି ହେବା କଥା ଅଛି। ଆମ ପାଠ ନିଜ ଘର କଥାରୁ ପଡ଼ୋଶୀଙ୍କୁ ଡାକିବାର ମୋଡ଼କୁ ଦେଖେ। କେହି ଆସିଲେ କି ବା ସତରେ ଚୋର ପଶିଥିଲା କି, ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ପ୍ରମାଣ କରେନାହିଁ। ସମ୍ବୋଧନର ମାଇ ଶବ୍ଦର ଭୂମିକା ଅନିଶ୍ଚିତ ରହିଛି।
entries.english_summary: Our reading follows the outward call without inventing a rescue.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଡାକକୁ ଅନୁସରେ, ଉଦ୍ଧାରର ଘଟଣା ଯୋଡ଼େନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠକମାନେ ଆହ୍ୱାନର ସ୍ୱରରେ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ପଢ଼ିଲେ। କଥାଟି କେବଳ ଡାକରେ ଶେଷ ହେଉଛି ବୋଲି ସେମାନେ ଲକ୍ଷ କଲେ। / Readers voice the alarm and notice its unresolved ending. This reading scene is invented.
entries.cultural_context: Exact ମାଇ ପଡ଼ିଶା is retained; the vocative nuance is uncertain. No spouse, gender, actual crime or universal settlement practice is established.

entries.title: A raft made of Hari’s name
entries.literal_meaning: Keep Hari’s name bound as a raft.
entries.explanation: The divine name becomes the material of an imagined raft. The dictionary places this line under using a means to accomplish something, after the literal raft-making sense. Our reading keeps that devotional metaphor without supplying an unnamed destination or guaranteed result. The source does not describe a particular crossing or establish the practice’s efficacy.
entries.meaning_odia: ହରିନାମ ଏଠାରେ କଳ୍ପିତ ଭେଳାର ଉପାଦାନ ହେଉଛି। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ସାଧନ ପାଇଁ ଉପାୟ ଅବଲମ୍ବନ କରିବା ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି; ତାପୂର୍ବରୁ ପ୍ରକୃତ ଭେଳା ତିଆରି କରିବା ଅର୍ଥ ରହିଛି। ଆମ ପାଠ ଭକ୍ତିମୂଳକ ରୂପକକୁ ରଖେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଅକୁହା ଗନ୍ତବ୍ୟ ବା ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ଫଳ ଯୋଡ଼େନାହିଁ। କୌଣସି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ପାରିହେବା ଘଟଣା ବା ସାଧନାର ସଫଳତା ଏଥିରୁ ପ୍ରମାଣିତ ହୁଏନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading preserves the devotional means-image without promising its outcome.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଭକ୍ତିର ଉପାୟ-ଚିତ୍ରକୁ ରଖେ, ଫଳର ପ୍ରତିଶ୍ରୁତି ଦିଏନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଜଣେ ପାଠକ ନାମରୁ ଭେଳା ହେବାର ରୂପକ ଆଲୋଚନା କଲେ। ସେ ଏହାକୁ ପ୍ରକୃତ ନୌକାର ସୁରକ୍ଷା ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ ଭାବେ ପଢ଼ିଲେ ନାହିଁ। / A reader discusses the metaphor rather than treating it as boating advice. This discussion is invented.
entries.cultural_context: No sect, author, salvation guarantee or life-ocean setting is supplied. Earlier B31 religious-boat wording shares imagery but is not certified as the same saying.

entries.odia: ଚୋରି କରିବ, ମହତ ଲୋକର ହାବୁଡ଼େ ପଡ଼ିବ
entries.title: Wrongdoing meets magnanimity
entries.literal_meaning: You will steal; you will encounter a magnanimous person.
entries.explanation: The line brings theft and an encounter with a magnanimous person together. The first dictionary sense supplies generosity of character, not merely wealth or rank. Our reading attends to the tension between the act and the person encountered. It leaves the encounter’s result open: the source promises neither pardon nor reform and is not a recommendation to steal.
entries.meaning_odia: ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଚୋରି ଓ ଜଣେ ଉଦାରମନା ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ ସହ ଭେଟକୁ ପାଖାପାଖି ରଖେ। ଅଭିଧାନର ପ୍ରଥମ ଅର୍ଥରେ ଉଦାରତା ଅଛି, କେବଳ ଧନ ବା ପଦମର୍ଯ୍ୟାଦା ନୁହେଁ। ଆମ ପାଠ କାମଟି ଓ ଭେଟୁଥିବା ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ ଗୁଣ ମଧ୍ୟର ଟାଣକୁ ଦେଖେ। ଭେଟର ଫଳ ଅକୁହା ରହେ—କ୍ଷମା ବା ଚରିତ୍ର ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନର ପ୍ରତିଶ୍ରୁତି ନାହିଁ। ଏହାକୁ ଚୋରି କରିବାର ପରାମର୍ଶ ଭାବେ ନିଆଯାଉନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading keeps the encounter unresolved instead of inventing forgiveness.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଭେଟର ଫଳକୁ ଅକୁହା ରଖେ, କ୍ଷମାର ଘଟଣା ଯୋଡ଼େନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠଚକ୍ରରେ ଜଣେ ଶେଷରେ କ୍ଷମା ମିଳିବ ବୋଲି ଭାବିଲେ। ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ ମନେ ପକାଇଲେ, ଧାଡ଼ିରେ ଫଳ କୁହାଯାଇନାହିଁ। / Readers distinguish their expected ending from what is actually stated. This discussion is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The quotation follows magnanimous sense1, not the later saintly sense3. No historical incident, immunity, compulsory mercy or fixed traditional moral is established.
